overall_reason: The article page gives the reader a 'Back to overview' button, one filled header action ('Get in touch') and a named phone menu, but the header does not mark 'Insights' as the section the reader is in, and the 'Industries' dropdown stayed open after Escape.

score.reason: T-PRIMARY-COUNT, T-PHONE-NAV and T-INTERRUPT pass; T-WHERE-AM-I finds no current mark past the home page and T-OVERLAY-CHECK records the 'Industries' menu still open after Escape (CMP-010, CMP-013).

visitor_mode: Read (inferred: an agency's insight article, 'Creating an Anti-AI Brand in Times of Artificial Everything', inside the site's Insights section)

findings.title: Navigation shows where you are
findings.evidence: The page is an article under /story/, reached from Insights, but the components table finds no current item in any of the three nav regions, and tiles/1440-00.png shows 'Insights' in the same weight and colour as 'Work', 'Services' and 'Careers'. The stylesheet does declare 15 current or selected rules, so the mark exists in the kit and is not applied here.
findings.before: Nothing in the header tells the reader which section this article belongs to.
findings.after: 'Insights' marked as the current section (underline or weight step, with aria-current="page" on the section link).
findings.why: A reader who lands on the article from search cannot see where it sits in the site, apart from the 'Back to overview' button.
findings.root: the site header component on article pages

findings.title: Overlays are the last answer and behave as overlays
findings.evidence: The capture opened the 'Industries' dropdown (overlays.triggers t0, kind menu, opened 'nav: Industries submenu'). After the capture pressed Escape and moved the pointer away, the row records closed_after_escape: false. The open still is a tight crop of the trigger, so the submenu's own look is not verified.
findings.before: The Industries submenu stays open after Escape and after the pointer leaves.
findings.after: The submenu closes on Escape with focus back on 'Industries', and on pointer leave after a 200 to 300 ms delay (CMP-158).
findings.why: A menu that ignores Escape stays over the article's headline for keyboard and pointer users alike.
findings.root: the Webflow dropdown used for 'Industries' and 'Technologies'

strengths: A '← Back to overview' button sits above the article title at both widths, so the reader has a way back to the list.
One filled header action, 'Get in touch', at both widths; at 375 the links move behind a named 'Open navigation menu' button (40 by 48 px).
The stylesheet declares hover (170), focus (21), focus-visible (14), active (13), disabled (10) and selected (15) rules, and the focus walk starts on 'skip to main content'.
The announcement strip at the top ('Discovery our cutting-edge AI offering') is part of the page flow, not a fixed bar or a modal, so nothing covers the article.
not_investigated: Visitor mode inferred from the page; there is no 00-contract.md.
Many requests were blocked in the capture (68, with 4 images; manifest.network), so some figures in the article may be missing; that is capture context.
The WhatsApp 'Send me the snippet' sign-up near the footer is a link with a QR code, not a form; T-FIELD-READ and T-ERROR-PATH found no form to follow.
What the phone menu holds: the capture opens triggers at 1440 only.
T-EMPTY-FIRST and T-TABLE-READ skipped: an article with no data region and no table.
The missing prefers-reduced-motion rule (sweep reduced_motion, A11-011) is lens-a11y's and lens-motion's.
